headline: إغلاق ناشر Fortis Games
line:
وفق جيمزبيت (GamesBeat):
الشركة أغلقت أبوابها

angle.hook: A publisher backed by Las Vegas Sands has closed and its live mobile game goes offline within days
angle.why_now: GamesBeat reported the closure on 10 November with a statement from the chief executive, and Twilight Towers goes offline on 16 November
angle.what_it_means_here: Another well funded games publisher exits, players of its live game have only days left, and the claim that its parent withdrew funding comes from a former employee and is not confirmed by the company
